loop.top3_series_pattern: seasonal_dominated, medium predictability, unstable model ranking
loop.top3_why: The median strategy is the most robust to unstable model rankings and correlated errors, which aligns with the diagnosis that the series has unstable model ranking and several correlated errors.  Median also performed best in the dataset‑wide validation (0.3336) and its per‑window errors are reasonably consistent, making it a safe choice for the blind test.
loop.top3_why_not: B (dba) has the lowest validation score but its per‑window errors are higher and the method is more sensitive to the high variance in weight estimation with only three windows.  C (mean) has a slightly better validation score than A but its per‑window errors are less stable and the mean is less robust to the identified ranking instability.  Therefore, median offers the best trade‑off between robustness and performance for this series.
